title: myosotis pusilla var. perpusilla
intro: Myosotis pusilla var. perpusilla, commonly known as Alpine Forget-me-not, is a rare and tiny flowering plant found in alpine regions. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing digestive issues, relieving respiratory problems, and reducing anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Myosotis pusilla var. perpusilla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
